00028 /**

00043 /**
00044  * @brief           Show or hide the application bar
00045  *
00046  * This function displays or hides the application bar.  When the application
00047  * bar is hidden, the application window uses the entire display.
00048  *
00049  * Note that hiding the application bar also hides the battery and the 
00050  * icon used to indicate alrams and messages.  The application bar should
00051  * be hidden only when necessary.
00052  *
00053  * If this call causes the application window size to change, a
00054  * kHxAppWindowResized message will be broadcast.
00055  *
00056  * @param show            IN:   true shows the application bar,
00057  *                              false hides the application bar
00058  *
00059  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.
00060  */
00061 HxResult HxApplicationBarShow(bool show);

00092 /**
00093  * @brief           Add a widget to the application bar
00094  *
00095  * This function adds the widget to the application bar.
00096  *
00097  * If the origin of the widget is set to (0, 0) when the widget is created, 
00098  * it is placed left-justified within the application bar.
00099  * Widgets are clipped if there is insufficient space.
00100  *
00101  * Using HxApplicationBarGetNextWidgetBounds, an application can customize
00102  * placement of widgets within the application bar.
00103  *
00104  * If the widget was hidden using HxWidgetSetVisible, this function makes
00105  * the widget visible.
00106  *
00107  * @param pWidget         IN:   Pointer to the widget to be added
00108  *
00109  * @return HxResult:            Returns HX_OK if successful.
00110  */
00111 HxResult HxApplicationBarAddWidget(HxWidget_t* pWidget);
